issue_context.title: flashback does not properly handle dropped tables
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```
use test;
create table t(a int);
select now();
insert into t values (1);
drop table t;
flashback cluster to timestamp 'xxx'; // flashback to timestamp before insert
select * from t;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

```
mysql> select * from t;
Empty set (0.01 sec)
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```
mysql> select * from t;
+------+
| a    |
+------+
|    1 |
+------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
```


### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

6ae151a9bc2dd2b4e7f7091a89d881c57cdebbc4
comments: Also find a bug with flashback dropped schema. I need to rethink the flashback key ranges.

review_comments: I think you could just use `EncodeMetaKey(key, nil)`?
